about: VacuumRecs starter catalog (2026-11-14): robot vacuums and robot vacuum-mop combos, cordless stick, upright, canister and handheld vacuums, wet/dry floor cleaners and carpet cleaners; owner build list 2026-11-12, build asked 2026-11-14. One product per model and generation: Dyson V15 Detect vs Gen5detect vs V12 Detect Slim, Roborock S8 MaxV Ultra vs Saros 10R vs Qrevo Curv, Roomba j7+ vs Combo j9+, Dreame L10s Ultra vs L20 Ultra vs X50 Ultra are separate; colours, retailer-exclusive SKUs and region variants that share a name merge (Miele Complete C3 variants share one page). Names and specs come from the makers' own pages; where a maker site refused automated fetches (Dyson, Shark, Bissell, Miele, Hoover, Dreame), from search excerpts of the maker page or a major retailer listing showing the maker's name. Specs: shape = category, surface = type, balance = the maker's headline suction (Pa for robots, AW for Dyson), core = runtime or Corded, weight = one headline feature. Blank = not confirmed. Years only where a dated page shows the launch.
